$comment: Copy for the VISIBLE Services section (the interactive card deck) — distinct from services.json, which is the catalogue of individual services, and from servicesSeo.json, which is the hidden crawlable version. Editable content — safe for a CMS. Headings are split into parts because each part carries a different gradient; keep the trailing space on `headingLeadTrail` (it separates the two halves when they wrap onto one line). `tabs.hint` is PERMANENT — it is the section's positioning line, not a coach-mark, so it is never dismissed; it may contain a {count} token, which is lifted out and set as its own badge, but it does not have to. `tabs.hintCompact` is the phone-width version. `ctaHref` must point at a route that exists — /our-services/ is generated from the nav tree.

content.intro: Most businesses juggle three agencies for this — and none of them talk to each other. Development. Marketing. Design. Built together under one roof.
content.description: Development that ships. Marketing that ranks. Design that converts. Plus every workflow and automation in between — run by one team, not stitched together from three agencies.
